config.name: pass_outcome_skillcorner_v2
config.description: Cross-provider replication after the second independent review: SkillCorner adapter v2 (restart, recovery and ball-out context from game_interruption_* and start_type; receiver from player_targeted_id; 2-frame release window at 10 fps; pipeline v2). Same rules/features/protocol as pass_outcome_v3. Supersedes pass_outcome_skillcorner_v1, whose event baseline lacked restart/recovery context.

physics_raw.description: uncalibrated PPCF x lane-clear estimate for the inferred receiver (no fitting)

physics_platt.description: physics estimate recalibrated with a 1-feature logistic regression

option_logreg.description: option model: per-target features computable for any receiver (serving model)

option_v2_logreg.description: option model + lead-pass target features (pre-specified v2 candidate)

Adt_logreg.description: decision-time event context only (no release features), LR

Bdt_logreg.description: decision-time event + spatial context (no release features), LR
